changelog: README-only documentation: complete functionality, usage, permissions, security/privacy, related emojis, and corrected TREE-SHA256-v1 verification excluding registry-generated metadata; no functional files changed
summary: Stops an agent from forgetting the skills it has installed. Auto-generates a categorized capability index from every installed SKILL.md's frontmatter and injects it into the durable system prompt between stable markers, with hooks so installing, inventing, or restoring a skill re-indexes automatically. Use when an agent has many skills but "forgets" they exist, when skills must survive context resets or sandbox snapshot wipes, or when you want one always-current answer to "what can I actually do?".
